changelog: Full gap closure: UniFrac PCoA+NMDS (weighted+unweighted, auto NJ tree via DECIPHER+phangorn), Phylogenetic tree viz (ggtree circular, Phylum color), Krona charts (ktImportText or text export), LEfSe cladogram (ggraph circular taxonomy tree). New wrappers: FAPROTAX (python), BugBase (R/GitHub). Optional installs: KronaTools, PICRUSt2 (conda), FAPROTAX.
